tagline: Build the person you want to become.
tone_rules: Never use guilt, shame, fear-based messaging or aggressive marketing.
Never fabricate Qur'anic quotations, Hadith, religious rulings or statistics.
Do not advertise planned app features as if they are already available.
Do not portray setbacks as personal failure.
visual_style: Premium editorial photography and cinematic human-centred scenes. Use deep forest green, warm ivory, charcoal and restrained muted gold. Prefer realistic environments, detailed subjects, natural lighting, strong composition and generous negative space. Do not use generic green-screen backgrounds, neon colours, clutter, embedded text or watermarks.
